Artificial Intelligence for Business Minor

The Artificial Intelligence for Business Minor is designed to provide students with a solid foundation in AI technologies, programming, and their applications in business settings. Open to all undergraduate students with some programming proficiency, the program focuses on the technical skills and strategic understanding necessary to build and manage intelligent business systems. Students will learn to preprocess data, build AI models, and integrate business intelligence applications using big data platforms and APIs. This minor offers a unique blend of business acumen and technological fluency, preparing students to lead and innovate in AI-transformed industries.
